_comment: Random appearance and backstory building blocks (built-in text, used without the AI).
mark: a burn scar on one hand
a white scar through one eyebrow
a slight limp from an old break
no distinguishing marks worth a watchman's time

opening: {name} was born in {home}, {years} years ago, in a hard {season} that people there still remember.
{name} grew up in {home}, the {nth} child of a family with more mouths than bread.
{name} was raised in {home}, among {culture} folk who expected little of the world and got less.
middle: {background_line} It left marks that have not faded.
closing: Now {pronoun} is on the road, with {coin} in {possessive} purse and no one to answer to.
{pronoun_cap} left with a pack, a grudge and a reason not to look back.
Whatever {pronoun} was, the road does not care; it only asks whether {pronoun} can keep walking.

background_lines.soldier: Years in the ranks taught {object} to march, to dig, and to keep quiet when officers argued over the dead.
background_lines.acolyte: The temple fed and clothed {object}, and taught {object} its prayers and which of its priests to fear.
background_lines.criminal: Cold nights and quick hands taught {object} a trade the watch would hang {object} for.
background_lines.folk_hero: When trouble came to the village it was {name} who stood up, and the village has never let {object} forget it.
background_lines.noble: Born to a name and land, {name} learned manners, swordplay and the thousand small cruelties of a great house.
background_lines.sage: Long years among books gave {object} learning, bad eyesight and a head full of unanswered questions.
background_lines.outlander: The wild country taught {object} to track, to hunt and to go days without speaking to another soul.
background_lines.guild_artisan: A guild master's beatings and a long apprenticeship made {object} good at a trade that pays badly.
